create_LSLSenderConfig: create an LSLSenderConfig with stream_name, stream_type, n_channels, unique_identifier, and sample_rate fields
setup_LSLSenderNode: setup an LSLSenderNode that creates a StreamInfo and StreamOutlet using the config parameters
publish_LSLMessage: publish LSLMessage data samples to an LSL stream outlet via the lsl_publisher subscriber method
review_LSLSenderNode: review the LSLSenderNode class that forwards LabGraph topic messages to an LSL stream outlet
refactor_lsl_publisher: refactor the lsl_publisher async method to handle sample pushing with configurable POLL_TIME intervals
